name: Bench Accounting
description: Bench provides online bookkeeping, tax preparation, financial reporting, advisory, and related accounting services for small businesses.
agentUseSummary: Bench Accounting cannot currently be connected as a Relay agent provider. Bench documents a customer portal and inbound financial integrations, and has described account-creation and financial-report APIs for selected embedded partners, but it publishes no supported public customer-account API, delegated OAuth contract, customer API key, remote MCP service, webhook schema, or distributable operation contract. Relay will not reuse portal sessions, capture financial credentials, automate the Bench app, or infer access to private partner endpoints.

blocked.label: Connect Bench Accounting
blocked.description: Bench publishes no supported public OAuth, customer API key, remote MCP, webhook, or other delegated Bench-account contract for Relay to implement. Partner-only API references do not establish customer authorization or general availability.

blocked.label: Access bookkeeping or financial data
blocked.description: Transactions, bank and card data, ledgers, books, reconciliations, reports, statements, receipts, invoices, payroll, tax records, messages, and customer documents are blocked without a supported authenticated API.

blocked.label: Perform bookkeeping, tax, or account actions
blocked.description: Categorization, account connection, document upload, user changes, journal or reconciliation work, closes, reporting, tax preparation or filing, messages, exports, and all other writes or submissions are blocked.

blocked.label: Use unsupported automation
blocked.description: Relay will not automate the Bench portal, reuse browser sessions, request magic links, capture Bench or financial-account credentials, invite itself into third-party systems, scrape reports, reverse-engineer private endpoints, or treat inbound integrations or private partner APIs as public Bench authority.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent actions can be enabled without a supported customer-authenticated Bench API or remote MCP contract with stable schemas and least-privilege authorization.

runtimeSupport.description: No customer-authenticated Bench Accounting operation is available to mount as OpenClaw tools.
No customer-authenticated Bench Accounting operation is available to mount as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: Bench documents a customer portal, human bookkeeping and tax teams, downloadable financial reports, Plaid-based bank feeds, inbound Stripe, Square, Shopify, Gusto, payroll, merchant, and third-party-login workflows, plus selected embedded partnerships. It does not publish a generally available Bench customer-account API, OAuth application contract, customer token, remote MCP service, webhook schema, stable operation schemas, sandbox, scopes, or revocation contract for independent third-party automation.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not expose Connect, request Bench or financial credentials, publish runtime tools, automate the Bench portal, or attempt private partner endpoints. Reconsider only if Bench publishes a supported customer-authenticated API or remote MCP service with stable schemas, least-privilege read scopes, revocation, audit semantics, financial-data controls, and human confirmation for bookkeeping, tax, account, and financial actions.

evidence.supports: Bench documents customer-initiated connections that bring Stripe, Square, Shopify, Gusto, merchant, payroll, and other financial data into Bench. These inbound integrations do not provide a customer-authenticated Bench API for Relay.

Bench uses Plaid inside its portal to import customer bank and card transactions and requires interactive financial-institution authentication. This grants Bench access to source accounts, not Relay access to Bench records.

Bench describes proprietary bookkeeping software, portal document uploads, downloadable financial reports, bank feeds, and automatic inbound payment-processor synchronization, but no public Bench customer API, OAuth flow, scopes, webhooks, or operation schemas.

Bench routes prospective partners to a partner manager and documents third-party portal logins for accountants. The current partner page does not publish developer documentation, customer authorization, API schemas, or self-service credentials.

Bench has marketed a Financial Reports API as part of an embedded partner solution. The page does not provide public documentation, authentication, scopes, schemas, sandbox access, revocation, or general customer availability, so Relay cannot safely infer an implementable contract.
